column5: Tên viết tắt và tên đầy đủ của công ty quản lý quỹ.
column20:
WITH
/* 1. NAV quỹ + số lượng quỹ */
nav_quy AS (
SELECT f.SEC_ID,
COUNT(DISTINCT fr.FUND_ID) AS so_quy,
SUM(fr.NAV) AS nav_tong
FROM FMS.FUND_REPORT fr
JOIN FMS.FUNDS f ON fr.FUND_ID = f.ID
WHERE f.DELETED = 0
AND TRIM(fr.PERIOD_REPORT) =
'Tháng ' || TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,5,2))
|| ' năm ' || SUBSTR(:p_date,1,4)
GROUP BY f.SEC_ID
),

/* 2. Hợp đồng UTDM */
utdm AS (
SELECT i.SEC_ID,
COUNT(DISTINCT ia.CONTRACT_NO) AS sl_hop_dong_utdm,
SUM(ir.LIST_VALUE) AS gttt_utdm
FROM FMS.INVES_REPORT ir
JOIN FMS.INVES_ACC ia ON ir.INVES_ACC_ID = ia.ID
JOIN FMS.INVES i ON ia.INVES_ID = i.ID
WHERE ia.DELETED = 0 AND i.DELETED = 0
AND TRIM(ir.PERIOD_REPORT) =
'Tháng ' || TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,5,2))
|| ' năm ' || SUBSTR(:p_date,1,4)
GROUP BY i.SEC_ID
),/* 3a. Chỉ tiêu tài chính (bán niên hoặc năm)
:p_fin_year = 2023
:p_fin_type = 1 (Bán niên) hoặc 2 (Năm) */
bctc AS (
SELECT sr.SEC_ID,
sr.CAPITAL_QTTY AS von_csh,
sr.PROFIT AS loi_nhuan,
sr.TLATTC_VALUE AS ty_le_attc
FROM FMS.SECURITIES_REPORT sr
WHERE TRIM(sr.PERIOD_REPORT_FINANCE) =
CASE :p_fin_type
WHEN 1 THEN 'Bán niên ' || :p_fin_year
WHEN 2 THEN 'Năm ' || :p_fin_year
END
AND TRIM(sr.PERIOD_REPORT_TLATTC) =
CASE :p_fin_type
WHEN 1 THEN 'Bán niên ' || :p_fin_year
WHEN 2 THEN 'Năm ' || :p_fin_year
END
),
/* 4. Kỳ xếp hạng
tháng 1-6 → PERIOD=1, YEAR = năm hiện tại - 1
tháng 7-12 → PERIOD=0, YEAR = năm hiện tại */
ky_rank AS (
SELECT rp.ID AS rating_pd_id
FROM FMS.RATING_PD rp
WHERE rp.STATUS = 1
AND rp.YEAR =
CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,5,2)) <= 6
THEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,1,4)) - 1
ELSE TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,1,4))
END
AND rp.PERIOD =
CASE WHEN TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,5,2)) <= 6
THEN 1
ELSE 0
END
),
/* 5. Xếp loại + điểm CAMEL */
rank_cty AS (
SELECT r.SEC_ID,
CASE r.RANK_TYPE
WHEN 1 THEN 'A'
WHEN 2 THEN 'B'
WHEN 3 THEN 'C'
WHEN 4 THEN 'D'
ELSE NULL
END AS xep_loai,
r.TOTAL_SCORE AS diem_camel
FROM FMS.RANK r
JOIN ky_rank k ON k.rating_pd_id = r.RT_PD_ID
),

/* 6. Tổng AUM toàn thị trường */
tong_tt AS (
SELECT SUM(NVL(n.nav_tong,0) + NVL(u.gttt_utdm,0)) AS tong_aum_tt
FROM FMS.SECURITIES s
LEFT JOIN nav_quy n ON n.SEC_ID = s.ID
LEFT JOIN utdm u ON u.SEC_ID = s.ID
WHERE s.DELETED = 0
)
SELECT
s.SHORT_NAME AS ma_cty,
s.NAME AS ten_cty,
s.CAPITAL AS von_dieu_le,
NVL(n.so_quy, 0) AS so_quy,
NVL(u.sl_hop_dong_utdm, 0) AS sl_hd_utdm,
-- NVL(n.nav_tong, 0) AS nav_cac_quy,
-- NVL(u.gttt_utdm, 0) AS gttt_utdm,
NVL(n.nav_tong,0) + NVL(u.gttt_utdm,0) AS tong_aum,
ROUND(
(NVL(n.nav_tong,0) + NVL(u.gttt_utdm,0)) * 100.0
/ NULLIF(tt.tong_aum_tt, 0)
, 2) AS thi_phan_pct,
b.von_csh,
b.loi_nhuan,
b.ty_le_attc,
rk.xep_loai,
rk.diem_camel
FROM FMS.SECURITIES s
LEFT JOIN nav_quy n ON n.SEC_ID = s.ID
LEFT JOIN utdm u ON u.SEC_ID = s.ID
LEFT JOIN bctc b ON b.SEC_ID = s.ID
LEFT JOIN rank_cty rk ON rk.SEC_ID = s.ID
CROSS JOIN tong_tt tt
WHERE s.DELETED = 0;

column20:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT_LIST AS ky_bao_cao,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_PUBLIC_STOCK) AS cp_niem_yet,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_PRIVATE_STOCK) AS cp_chua_niem_yet,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_BONDS) AS trai_phieu,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_OTHER_STOCK) AS ck_khac,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_OTHER_PROPERTY) AS tai_san_khac,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_MONEY) AS tien,
SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_PUBLIC_STOCK)
+ SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_PRIVATE_STOCK)
+ SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_BONDS)
+ SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_OTHER_STOCK)
+ SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_OTHER_PROPERTY)
+ SUM(FUND_REPORT.SUM_VAL_MONEY) AS tong_tai_san
FROM FMS.FUND_REPORT
JOIN FMS.FUNDS ON FUNDS.ID = FUND_REPORT.FUND_ID
WHERE FUNDS.DELETED = 0
AND TRIM(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT_LIST) =
'Tháng ' || TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(:p_date,5,2))
|| ' năm ' || SUBSTR(:p_date,1,4)
GROUP BY FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT_LIST
)
SELECT ky_bao_cao, N'Giá trị' AS loai_chi_tieu, cp_niem_yet, cp_chua_niem_yet, trai_phieu, ck_khac, tai_san_khac, tien FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT ky_bao_cao, N'Tỷ trọng',
ROUND(cp_niem_yet / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2),
ROUND(cp_chua_niem_yet / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2),
ROUND(trai_phieu / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2),
ROUND(ck_khac / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2),
ROUND(tai_san_khac / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2),
ROUND(tien / NULLIF(tong_tai_san,0) * 100, 2)
FROM base;

WITH base AS ( 
SELECT 
FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT AS ky_bao_cao, 
TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT), -4)) * 100 
+ TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT), 7, 
INSTR(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT, ' năm') - 7)) AS yyyymm, 
SUM(FUND_REPORT.NAV) AS tong_nav 
FROM FMS.FUND_REPORT 
JOIN FMS.FUNDS ON FUNDS.ID = FUND_REPORT.FUND_ID 
WHERE FUNDS.DELETED = 0 
AND TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT), -4)) * 100 
+ TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TRIM(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT), 7, 
INSTR(FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT, ' năm') - 7)) 
BETWEEN TO_CHAR(:p_from) AND TO_CHAR(:p_to) 
GROUP BY FUND_REPORT.PERIOD_REPORT 
), 
main AS ( 
SELECT 
cur.ky_bao_cao, 
cur.tong_nav, 
prv.tong_nav AS tong_nav_thang_truoc, 
ROUND( 
(cur.tong_nav - prv.tong_nav) * 100 / NULLIF(prv.tong_nav, 0) 
, 2) AS tang_truong_pct 
FROM base cur 
LEFT JOIN base prv 
ON prv.yyyymm = CASE WHEN MOD(cur.yyyymm, 100) = 1 
THEN cur.yyyymm - 89 
ELSE cur.yyyymm - 1 
END 
) 
SELECT 
ky_bao_cao, 
tong_nav, 
tong_nav_thang_truoc, 
tang_truong_pct, 
ROUND(AVG(tang_truong_pct) OVER (), 2) AS trung_binh_tang_truong_pct 
FROM main;

column20:
:p_from, :p_to NUMBER YYYYMM ví dụ: 202401, 202412

WITH ky_bc AS ( 
SELECT 
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:p_from, 'YYYYMM'), LEVEL - 1), 'YYYYMM')) AS yyyymm, 
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:p_from, 'YYYYMM'), LEVEL - 1), 'YYYY')) AS nam, 
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(:p_from, 'YYYYMM'), LEVEL - 1), 'Q')) AS quy 
FROM DUAL 
CONNECT BY LEVEL <= MONTHS_BETWEEN( 
TO_DATE(:p_to, 'YYYYMM'), 
TO_DATE(:p_from, 'YYYYMM') 
) + 1 
), 
base AS ( 
SELECT 
FUNDS.ID AS fund_id, 
FUND_TYPE.NAME AS loai_hinh_quy, 
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(FUNDS.ID_DATE, 'YYYYMM')) AS id_yyyymm, 
TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(NVL(FUNDS.DEC_DATE, 
TO_DATE('99991231', 'YYYYMMDD')), 'YYYYMM')) AS dec_yyyymm 
FROM FMS.FUNDS 
JOIN FMS.FUND_TYPE ON FUND_TYPE.ID = FUNDS.FTYPE_ID 
WHERE FUNDS.DELETED = 0 
AND FUND_TYPE.IS_DELETED = 0 
) 
SELECT * FROM ( 
SELECT 'Tháng' AS loai_ky, k.yyyymm AS ky, NULL AS ky_phu, b.loai_hinh_quy, COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) AS so_quy FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.yyyymm, b.loai_hinh_quy 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Tháng', k.yyyymm, NULL, N'Tổng Tháng', COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.yyyymm 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Quý', k.nam, k.quy, b.loai_hinh_quy, COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.nam, k.quy, b.loai_hinh_quy 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Quý', k.nam, k.quy, N'Tổng Quý', COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.nam, k.quy 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Năm', k.nam, NULL, b.loai_hinh_quy, COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.nam, b.loai_hinh_quy 
UNION ALL 
SELECT 'Năm', k.nam, NULL, N'Tổng Năm', COUNT(DISTINCT b.fund_id) FROM base b JOIN ky_bc k ON b.id_yyyymm <= k.yyyymm AND b.dec_yyyymm >= k.yyyymm GROUP BY k.nam 

) 
ORDER BY 
CASE loai_ky WHEN 'Năm' THEN 1 WHEN 'Quý' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, 
ky, ky_phu, loai_hinh_quy;

#-- [QĐT-10-MASTER] Thông tin tổng hợp danh sách quỹ đầu tư
SELECT
f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_quy,
f.NAME AS ten_quy,
sec.NAME AS cong_ty_quan_ly,
ft.NAME AS phan_loai,
bm.NAME AS ngan_hang_giam_sat,
-- Số lượng đại lý phân phối
(SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM FMS.AGEN_FUNDS af
JOIN FMS.AGENCIES a ON af.AGENCY_ID = a.ID
WHERE af.FUND_ID = f.ID
AND a.STATUS = 1
AND a.DELETED = 0
) AS sl_dai_ly_phan_phoi,
-- Số lượng thành viên ban đại diện
(SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM FMS.REPRESENT rp
WHERE rp.FUND_ID = f.ID
AND rp.STATUS = 1
AND rp.DELETED = 0
) AS sl_thanh_vien_bdd,
-- Số lượng người điều hành quỹ
(SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM FMS.FUND_TL_PRO ftp
JOIN FMS.TL_PROFILES tlp ON ftp.TLPR_ID = tlp.ID
WHERE ftp.FUND_ID = f.ID
AND tlp.DELETED = 0
AND tlp.STATUS = 1
) AS sl_nguoi_dieu_hanh
FROM FMS.FUNDS f
JOIN FMS.SECURITIES sec ON f.SEC_ID = sec.ID
JOIN FMS.FUND_TYPE ft ON f.FTYPE_ID = ft.ID
LEFT JOIN FMS.BANK_MONI bm ON f.BANK_ID = bm.ID
WHERE f.DELETED = 0
ORDER BY ft.NAME, f.SHORT_NAME;

-- [QĐT-DL] Danh sách đại lý phân phối từng quỹ
SELECT
f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_quy,
a.SHORT_NAME AS ma_dai_ly,
a.NAME AS ten_dai_ly,
a.ADDRESS AS dia_chi
FROM FMS.AGEN_FUNDS af
JOIN FMS.AGENCIES a ON af.AGENCY_ID = a.ID
JOIN FMS.FUNDS f ON af.FUND_ID = f.ID
WHERE f.DELETED = 0
AND a.STATUS = 1
AND a.DELETED = 0
ORDER BY f.SHORT_NAME, a.NAME;

---- Danh sách thành viên ban đại diện 
SELECT
f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_quy,
rp.NAME AS ten_thanh_vien
FROM FMS.REPRESENT rp
JOIN FMS.FUNDS f ON rp.FUND_ID = f.ID
JOIN FMS.STATUS s ON f.STATUS_ID = s.ID
WHERE rp.STATUS = 1
AND rp.DELETED = 0
AND f.DELETED = 0
AND s.IS_ACTIVE = 1
ORDER BY f.SHORT_NAME, rp.NAME;

------- Danh sách người điều hành 
SELECT 
f.SHORT_NAME AS ma_quy, 
tlp.NAME AS ten_nguoi_dieu_hanh 
FROM FMS.FUND_TL_PRO ftp 
JOIN FMS.TL_PROFILES tlp ON ftp.TLPR_ID = tlp.ID 
JOIN FMS.FUNDS f ON ftp.FUND_ID = f.ID 
JOIN FMS.STATUS s ON f.STATUS_ID = s.ID 
WHERE f.DELETED = 0 
AND tlp.DELETED = 0 
AND s.IS_ACTIVE = 1 
ORDER BY f.SHORT_NAME, tlp.NAME;
